rows.grounds: neuter noun naming the textual unit
adjective describing the chapter count as finished
past participle indicating examination or touching
demonstrative pronoun in the closing formula
closing term of the om-tat-sat formula

items.question: What closing statement marks the completed and reviewed thirty-chapter work?
items.inference: The verse declares the thirty-chapter work completed and reviewed, ending with om tat sat.
uncertainties: parāmṛṣṭam may mean reviewed or touched
paṭalam may refer to chapters or sections
items.plain_english: Thirty chapters are completed and reviewed. Om tat sat.
